videos.title: EXACTLY How To Master Braking in GT3 Cars with @LaurenceDusoswa
videos.creator: Coach Dave Academy
videos.summary: Coach Dave uses Delta traces to coach Laurence Dusoswa on GT3 brake shape, consistency, and earlier throttle — the same pedal-target idea LapSimPro shows in the overlay.

videos.title: THIS HIGH-LEVEL STUDENT FOUND 1 SECOND PER LAP! - Sim Racing Coaching
videos.creator: Suellio Almeida
videos.summary: Often cited in iRacing trail-braking threads. Suellio coaches a high-iRating driver to rotate with brake release instead of extra steering — not a generic 'how to trail brake' title, despite how the clip is shared.

videos.title: 5 Reasons You Need to Trail Brake in Sim Racing
videos.creator: Driver61 Sim Racing
videos.summary: Scott Mansell walks iRacing brake traces at Silverstone and the Nürburgring: max straight-line pressure, then a smooth release so the front stays loaded into the apex.

videos.title: How to Trail Brake: A Step-by-Step Guide
videos.creator: Driver61
videos.summary: Driver61's technique lesson on blending brake and steer, when to trail more in slow corners, and when to release earlier in high-speed ones.

videos.title: What Does Brake Bias Do? iRacing Tutorial with @davecamyt
videos.creator: TraxionGG
videos.summary: Dave Cam in the Ferrari 488 GT3 at the Red Bull Ring: front vs rear bias, trail-brake corners vs straight-line stops, and why fixed-series cars still let you move the percentage.

videos.title: How To Use Brake Bias - Sim Racing's Secret Switch
videos.creator: Danny Lee
videos.summary: Practical bias rules: more front for stability and confidence, less front for rotation and shorter stops — including iRacing F8 adjustments and fixed-setup series.

videos.title: Trailbraking In Sim Racing - How Slowing Down the Right Way Makes You Faster
videos.creator: Danny Lee
videos.summary: Clear visual of trail vs dump-the-brake, with an iRacing Ferrari fixed-setup example at Summit Point showing later marks and higher average entry speed.

videos.title: 9 Things No One Tells You About iRacing When You Start Sim Racing
videos.creator: VRS Sim Racing
videos.summary: VRS ambassador Trebol on consistency, braking first, replays, telemetry vs a coach reference, iRating/safety rating, and why default open setups are built to be safe.

videos.title: Sim Racing Coach Part 1 - Braking Tutorial Motec i2 Pro. How to improve by 1+ seconds a lap.
videos.creator: GP Race Simulation
videos.summary: MoTeC i2 walkthrough of a common amateur trace: not reaching 100% brake, slow application, and dumping the pedal instead of a trail release — often worth more than a second.

videos.title: Biggest Sim Racing Tips (sim driver analysis)
videos.creator: Driver61
videos.summary: Scott Mansell coaches an onboard: vision to the apex, earlier turn-in, a breath of trail into the apex, and smooth throttle so technique is fixed before setup.
